title: Corbell and Coulthart find witnesses who place Lazar at S4
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Corbell and Coulthart find witnesses who place Lazar at S4, about late 1980s at S4, Nevada, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Jeremy Corbell and Ross Coulthart found a bunch of people who have verified Bob's presence at S4, right?

plain: Bob Lazar is a man who has said he worked in the late 1980s at S4, a secret test site in the Nevada desert, on craft that he believed were not made by humans. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a filmmaker, Jeremy Corbell, and a journalist, Ross Coulthart, found a number of people who confirm that Lazar was really there. If so, it would back up the core of Lazar's much-doubted story.
